name: The Name of the Beast
label: Quest
description: The Name of the Beast: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: She kills my children, mortal. She that calls herself the ruler of these oceans. A false god, nothing more. Crush her and bring back all of her heads.
For that, you will be given the name that you seek and something else of equal importance.
She roams the clutch... Hetaera she is called.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Finally, one worthy of the wisdom of Arkkoroc!
